provenance: NATS documentation commit 698b2b8a5add153062e7d8d58b5599d5a1609e3d (https://github.com/nats-io/nats.docs.v2/tree/698b2b8a5add153062e7d8d58b5599d5a1609e3d). The publisher's 2.15-series reference is generated using nats-server v2.15.0 and jsm.go v0.5.0 and applies to the managed 2.15 series. The publisher's Docusaurus build expands original client examples. Devline extracts article bodies, flattens tabs under their original labels, and retains highlighted examples as plain code. See NOTICE-EXAMPLES for source snapshots and client example licensing.
coverage: NATS concepts, tutorials and Learn guides, plus the 2.15 server configuration, protocols, monitoring, authentication, JetStream APIs, operational reference, and version-series upgrade guides.
omissions: Patch-specific 2.15.2 release notes (https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/tag/v2.15.2), other reference versions, linked external content, and interactive demonstrations are outside this snapshot.
